group.doc: Group of units that were all commanded to reach the same point.

unreachableBuildings.doc: All encountered unreachable buildings of this AI. Why a sequence? Because contains() is very rarely called on it.

readAttackTarget.doc: ID of unit read as target. This is set up after reading. Do not access!

command.doc: Current command this unit is following.

stances.doc: Stance, usually related to firing mode. Each bit is a stance ID.
